name: Casino Dominican
description: Casino Dominican is a Royal Casino variant played in the Dominican Republic. Picture cards have numerical values (J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14). Features unique building rules, sweep scoring, and special endgame scoring when nearing 21 points. Played counter-clockwise.

content.text: Casino Dominican is a Royal Casino variant played in the Dominican Republic. Picture cards have numerical values (J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14). Features unique building rules, sweep scoring, and special endgame scoring when nearing 21 points. Played counter-clockwise.

Casino Dominican is a variant of Royal Casino played in the Dominican Republic. Royal Casino (where picture cards have numerical values) is the standard form in many countries outside Britain and North America. The Dominican version was documented by Humbernio Lockward.
2-4 players. 4 players play in fixed partnerships (partners opposite). Deal and play counter-clockwise.
Standard 52-card pack. Card values: K=13, Q=12, J=11, 10-2=face value, A=1 or 14 (player's choice).
First deal: 4 cards to each player, 4 face up to table (separate, all visible). Subsequent deals: 4 cards each, no more table cards. Dealer announces 'last' on final deal. Deal passes to the right.
